description.value: La Forchetta is an owner-operated Italian restaurant on Hastings Street in Burnaby, helmed by Chef Manrico whose culinary roots lie in the coastal Abruzzo region of Italy. All pastas are handmade daily in-house, reflecting the fresh, tradition-driven flavours of his home neighbourhood of Borgo Marino in Pescara. It is a sit-down dining destination with table reservations and online ordering, making it a solid stop for a cycling-day meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record carries a check_date of 2025-08-05 and looks_closed=false, confirming the restaurant was recently verified as operational. The website corroborates the address (5601 Hastings St, Burnaby) and phone (+1 604-294-1121), and the front-page 'Order Now' button supports takeout availability. Gluten-free pasta is explicitly called out in the menu section; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, pump, etc.) appear anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Website footer references 'the latest PHO orders' (BC Provincial Health Orders from the COVID-19 era), indicating the site has not been substantially updated since roughly 2020-2022, despite the business appearing to still be active per OSM check_date 2025-08-05.
Website copyright reads 2019; hours are deferred entirely to Google rather than listed on-site, making independent verification of current operating days difficult.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational Italian restaurant on Hastings Street in Burnaby, verified by OSM check-date of August 2025 and corroborated by an active website with consistent contact details.
enrichment_extras.notes: Payment methods confirmed on website: Cash, Debit, Visa, and Mastercard accepted; AMEX not accepted.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website menu section states 'Gluten free pasta available' with extra cooking time
